[[Gavel of the Nephilim (unique)|Gavel of the Nephilim]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] traded by the [[Adept of Steel]], a [[collector]] who can be found in the [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]]: -1
:Health +30

==Trivia==
* The name is from the Biblical term "Nephilim," which loosely translates to "giants" or "titans."
* This weapon's design was a [http://www.guildwars.com/events/contests/designaweapon/winner05.php winner] in Arenanet's Design-a-Weapon Contest.
